patch.value: All evidence pointers, traceability links, findings references, and decision citations in canonical artifacts SHALL use a single standard: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer objects with required fields {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note} referencing versioned JSON artifacts. Implementations MAY include additional optional metadata fields (e.g., candidate_id, artifact_id, quote) so long as the required fields are present and validators treat extra fields as non-authoritative.

An RFC 6901 JSON Pointer object with required fields {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note} referencing a versioned JSON artifact location; optional metadata fields may be present but must not replace/contradict the required fields.

All evidence pointers include required fields {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note} with json_pointer starting with '/' and resolving to a valid path; optional metadata fields are permitted but ignored for compliance; any missing required field or invalid json_pointer causes validation failure.
